// diagnostic

E3412

`core.net.{method}()` is not available at comptime.

What

`core.net.{method}()` is not available at comptime.

Why

Only `core.net.fetch(url, sha256:)` is supported at compile time as a Tier-1 hermetic effect. Other `core.net` methods are not planned for comptime access.

Fix

use `core.net.fetch(url, sha256: "…")` for content-hash-pinned downloads.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3412: tests/ui/impure_net_stub.stderr.

Error [E3412]: `core.net.tcp_connect()` is not available at comptime
  --> tests/ui/impure_net_stub.jet:6:22
    |
  6 |         @conn :: net.tcp_connect("build.example.com:443")
    |                      ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only `core.net.fetch(url, sha256:)` is supported at compile time
 Fix: use `core.net.fetch(url, sha256: "<hash>")` for content-hash-pinned downloads
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3412

Error [E0107]: nothing named `@conn` exists here
  --> tests/ui/impure_net_stub.jet:7:28
    |
  7 |         print("connected: {@conn}")
    |                            ^^^^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `@conn :: ...`
